mostWorthwhile.text: Building the new connective tissue made the fibroblasts’ contribution concrete: they lay down collagen to support the wound.

leastWorthwhile.text: The healing-skin picture described a continuous surface and supporting tissue before either was fitted, making the wound’s state confusing.

surprise.text: The final result clarified that the clot is temporary while the new tissue remains and its collagen continues to change.

arbitrary.text: The fittings had clear purposes, but they added little explanation and the later choices were effectively prescribed by the available options.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter if it explored a new relationship as clearly as the capillary sprout and collagen did, though the repeated fittings made this chapter feel predictable.
